meta.title: Add parallel test runner
meta.body_summary: Add Bash and PowerShell scripts to run Catch2 tests in parallel via sharding, update CI workflows and README, claiming faster execution.

perf_labels.notes: Codex added parallel test runner scripts but maintainer found no CI speed improvement, leading to PR closure.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 98 changed lines, this is a very small CI‑infrastructure edit. It was closed because the expected performance benefit from parallel test sharding was not observed, not because of review objections.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer closed PR after observing that CI runtime did not improve with parallel sharding.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce CI test execution time by running Catch2 tests in parallel across multiple CPUs.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR with comment 'Doesn't seem to make the CI run faster'.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Parallel test sharding is a common optimization but in this project it did not reduce overall runtime; the agent failed to validate the performance gain before proposing the change.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Maintainer ran the CI with the parallel scripts deployed and did not observe any speed improvement.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or before/after timing data provided; only maintainer's informal observation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge because performance improvement was not realized.

core_change_summary.description: Added Bash and PowerShell scripts to shard Catch2 tests across CPUs using --shard-count and --shard-index. Updated GitHub Actions workflows (build.yml, coverage.yml) to invoke the parallel runner instead of the test binary directly. Updated README with documentation for sequential and parallel test execution.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: CI workflow changes are mostly one‑line script invocations; README adds usage examples.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (6c212326): Added Bash parallel run script, updated Linux CI and README.
Second commit (b7f71b1): Added Windows PowerShell parallel runner and updated workflow.

review_signals.summary: CoderaRabbit bot commented with actionable nits: hard‑coded test binary path, nproc portability, trap fix, argument quoting, and markdown linting.
Second bot review highlighted PowerShell script issues: missing build dir in path, NUM_JOBS validation, and argument quoting.
Maintainer closed PR noting that the parallel runner did not make CI faster.

collaboration_trajectory: Codex opened PR with Linux parallel runner.
CodeRabbit bot reviewed with script nits.
Author added Windows runner and fixed issues.
Maintainer closed PR after observing no CI speed improvement.
